evidence.evidence_text: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) is a multidisciplinary task that generates LaTeX sequences from images.
Experiments show that RLFN outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on the CROHME 2014/2016/2019 datasets.

To validate our proposition, we propose an architecture called Recognize and Language Fusion Network (RLFN), which integrates recognition and language features to output corrected sequences while jointly optimizing with a string decoder recognition model.
